steps.template_en: 'MGFs always exist.' WRONG! Cauchy has NO moments and NO MGF. Characteristic functions φ_X(t)=E[e^{itX}] ALWAYS exist (|e^{itX}|=1). They're the RIGHT tool for studying convergence.
steps.template_zh: 'MGF总存在。'错！Cauchy无矩无MGF。特征函数φ_X(t)=E[e^{itX}]总存在。研究收敛的正确工具。

steps.template_en: φ_X(t)=E[cos(tX)]+iE[sin(tX)]. Properties: φ(0)=1. |φ(t)|≤1. φ_{aX+b}(t)=e^{ibt}φ_X(at). If X,Y independent: φ_{X+Y}=φ_Xφ_Y.
Examples: N(0,1): φ(t)=e^{-t²/2}. Bernoulli(p): 1-p+pe^{it}. Poisson(λ): exp(λ(e^{it}-1)). Cauchy: e^{-|t|}. Uniform(0,1): (e^{it}-1)/(it).
Lévy Continuity: Xₙ→X in dist ⟺ φ_{Xₙ}→φ_X pointwise and limit continuous at 0. CLT proof: φ_{√n(X̄ₙ-μ)/σ}(t)=(φ_{X₁-μ}(t/(σ√n)))ⁿ→e^{-t²/2}. Cleanest proof of CLT.
steps.template_zh: Lévy连续性定理。CLT证明：φ_{√n(X̄ₙ-μ)/σ}(t)→e^{-t²/2}。CLT最干净证明。

steps.template_en: (1) CF of Exp(λ). (2) CF of X̄ for Exp(λ) sample. (3) Use CFs to show sum of n i.i.d. Exp(λ) ~ Gamma(n,λ). (4) Show Cauchy is STABLE: average of Cauchy is still Cauchy.
steps.template_zh: (1)Exp(λ)的CF。(2)Exp(λ)样本X̄的CF。(3)用CF证i.i.d.Exp(λ)和~Gamma(n,λ)。(4)Cauchy稳定：平均还是Cauchy。

steps.template_en: Characteristic functions = most elegant tool: ALWAYS exist, uniquely determine distribution (inversion), convert sums → products. They're the 'Fourier transform' of probability — bridge between time and frequency domains.
steps.template_zh: 特征函数=最优雅工具：总是存在、唯一确定分布、将和→积。概率的'傅里叶变换'——时域频域桥梁。
